name: imobrag
description: ImobRAG — frontend e API Fastify para consulta documental

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm start -w backend" "npm start -w frontend"
scripts.check: npm run check -w backend && npm run check -w frontend
